It is a RECORD, not a certification: it names, per acceptance criterion, which sub-claims a specific test, artifact or commit establishes on the pinned worktree tip, which are open with a named counterexample, and which are unexecuted with nothing to reuse. The CLI evidence block on the spec carries pass/unchecked per criterion and is the close authority; this file carries the finer grain the CLI status cannot express. Every expensive result is one of: OBSERVED on the pinned tip, REUSED from a named execution with the inputs it depended on shown unchanged, or UNEXECUTED. Results marked OBSERVED were measured on the named integration candidate (see pins.integrationCandidate); the tip they were taken at is named per block.
